comment: botl.c compare_blstats() for BL_TERRAIN. A xorn (wizard-mode #polyself) walks from the up stairs into the room's west wall, down to the south-west corner, and east along the south wall to the south-east corner and the rock beyond, with terrainstatus and a 'changed' rule on terrain. compare_blstats() compares BL_TERRAIN as the terrain_typ number, yet the recorder highlights only Stairs->Wall and Wall->Stone, not the moves between wall types that share the text "Wall". The JavaScript status therefore compares terrain by its text; a port that compares the number fails this recording.
